 Hailey Bieber takes Rhode beyond beauty with its first fashion launch
 The brand’s new collection marks Hailey Bieber’s 30th birthday celebrations

 In a world where celebrity-founded beauty brands are constantly vying for attention, Hailey Bieber ’s Rhode continues to carve out its own space. 
 Since launching in 2022, the brand has built a cult following for its pared-down skincare and makeup essentials, with each new drop garnering as much excitement among Gen Z as among beauty editors. 
 Now, Rhode is stepping beyond beauty with its latest launch: a limited-edition ready-to-wear capsule.
 Available to pre-order from today, the launch not only marks Hailey Rhode Bieber’s 30th birthday, but also a new chapter for the brand, introducing its first-ever wearable merchandise alongside exclusive beauty launches and accessories.
 At the heart of the drop is an oversized reversible windbreaker – already sold out in most sizes, naturally. Here’s everything you need to know. 
 Rhode windbreaker 
 Rhode Designed to be worn two ways, the windbreaker features navy nylon on one side and grey fleece on the other. The off-duty staple is said to take inspiration from Bieber’s love of vintage sportswear. 
 £148, Rhode.com But the fashion offering is just one part of the birthday collection. Rhode is also introducing Pocket Plush (£16, Rhodeskin.com ), its first-ever matte blush, in two limited-edition shades: Baldwin, a berry rose, and Tucson, a rich burgundy. The creamy, buildable formula can be applied to both cheeks and lips, delivering a soft-focus matte finish. 
 There's also a birthday-exclusive Peptide Lip Boost (£23, Rhodeskin.com ) in a sheer, shimmery pink with a cherry vanilla cola scent, alongside new navy variations of the cult Peptide Eye Prep patches (£25, Rhodeskin.com ).
 Rhode And that’s not all. Two new accessories join the rhode roster, including a structured navy Carry Case (£38, Rhodeskin.com ) designed to keep beauty and travel essentials organised. 
 For those wanting to get their hands on the entire birthday edit, the £55 Birthday Set bundles both Pocket Plush shades with the new Cherry Vanilla Cola Peptide Lip Boost.
